# Mini corpus attribution

Test fixture for CI (spec §10.2). Text is derived from the open access articles below, each published under the Creative Commons Attribution licence (CC BY). The text was parsed and cleaned by `antibros ingest` (references, acknowledgements and table cells removed) and chunked by the `section_aware` chunker; no other changes were made.

- Ryan Burke, Alec Piñero, Max Coleman et al. (2023). *The Effects of Creatine Supplementation Combined with Resistance Training on Regional Measures of Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis* Nutrients. doi:10.3390/nu15092116. https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC10180745. Licence: CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- Brad Jon Schoenfeld, Alan Aragon, Colin Wilborn et al. (2017). *Pre- versus post-exercise protein intake has similar effects on muscular adaptations* PeerJ. doi:10.7717/peerj.2825. https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC5214805. Licence: CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- Brad Jon Schoenfeld, Alan Albert Aragon (2018). *How much protein can the body use in a single meal for muscle-building? Implications for daily protein distribution* Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition. doi:10.1186/s12970-018-0215-1. https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC5828430. Licence: CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
